headline: Senate pushing through amendments on Africa trade deal while navigating judicial confirmations and athlete rights debate!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate confirmed CDC Director Erica Schwartz 51-44 and passed the Northern Border Security Enhancement Act with an amendment. The chamber spent much of the day debating amendments to H.R. 6500, the AGOA Extension Act, with cloture votes set for Friday on multiple amendments and on Todd Blanche's nomination for Attorney General.
